records.description: Binance's self-custodial wallet, originally launched as Binance Web3 Wallet, was rebranded as Binance Wallet in December 2024 with a refreshed interface and additional features.
records.notes: Current first-party Binance Academy material supports December 2024 but not a defensible day-level rebrand date in this review. WLR therefore preserves month precision and uses an approximate date basis. This is continuity, not a new wallet or product launch.
records.title: Binance Web3 Wallet rebranded as Binance Wallet
